name: @call-booking/contract
description: TypeSpec sources of the API contract. `make generate` emits the OpenAPI spec, the TS types consumed by server/ and the client SDK for web/ (@hey-api/openapi-ts, needs Node >= 22.18). Generated artifacts are committed and never hand-edited.

scripts.generate: tsp compile . && openapi-typescript openapi.yaml -o ../server/src/generated/schema.d.ts && openapi-ts && node scripts/post-generate.mjs
